suite: v0.7.8.5 Government, Leadership and Capitals Chromium integration

tests.test: Fresh world starts with an empty political registry and existing NPC records
Complete political record can reference an existing capital and NPC ID
Complete entity summary returns type, government, capital name and referenced leader name
Territory ownership and valid capital location pass political validator
No NPC record or geography copy was created for political leadership
Partial entity without government, ruler, title or capital remains valid
Controlled region count is reported only from explicit owner/governor assignments
Unresolved leader NPC ID is reported without creating an NPC
Capital outside known political territory is rejected
Existing location NPC can resolve through the v06 saved-person overlay
Summary lookup is read-only for sites, routes, and geography index
Actual save-slot round trip preserves government, capital, and leader references
Leader resolves after actual save-slot reload
Load preserves canonical physical site/route counts without duplicates
